newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-STOCKTON 3-POINTER PUTS UTAH INTO FIRST FINALS.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-STOCKTON 3-POINTER PUTS UTAH INTO FIRST FINALS.

text.p: John Stockton's 3-pointer at the buzzer shot the Utah Jazz into the NBA Finals for the first time with a 103-100 victory over the Houston Rockets Thursday.

Stockton took the inbound pass from Bryon Russell behind a pick from Karl Malone and had a wide-open look from the top of the arc. Rockets forward Charles Barkley was too late coming over and Stockton's shot swished through at the buzzer.
"I'm just glad it went in," said the veteran point guard. "I'm very excited."

Stockton leaped in celebration with his fist in the air and was mobbed by his teammates as more than a decade of frustration for the Jazz came to an end. The stunned crowd fell silent as Rockets players walked off the court, their dreams of a third NBA title in four years ended.

The Jazz won the Western Conference finals 4-2 and will play the defending champion Chicago Bulls for the NBA title beginning on Sunday. Utah reached the conference finals in four of the last six years but had never made the Finals.
"This is unbelievable," said Malonem, "what we've been through as a team. Everybody stuck together and believed in each other. It's awesome, it's totally awesome."

The shot capped a stunning rally by the Jazz, who trailed by 13 points with less than seven minutes to play. Stockton scored 15 of his 25 points in the fourth quarter, including Utah's last nine in the final 83 seconds.

"We knew we weren't out of it," said Stockton. "We knew our guys wouldn't give up. Nobody gave up, and all we had to do was get back in the ball game and they might tighten up a little bit. I'm just so happy we got that done."
